description: List agents in your account (a single page, sized by limit). An agent is required before you can make calls — it owns phone numbers and handles voice/SMS. Returns each agent's ID, name, voice configuration, and attached phone numbers.

limit.description: How many agents to return in one page.

name: list_agents

items.description: An AgentPhone agent and its configuration.

beginMessage.description: Opening line the hosted AI speaks, or null.

denoisingMode.description: Audio denoising mode applied to calls.

description.description: Free-text note about the agent's purpose.

enableBackchannel.description: Whether the agent interjects 'mhmm' while the caller speaks.

enableMessaging.description: Whether the hosted agent can send/read texts mid-call.

id.description: The agent's unique ID (use as agent_id elsewhere).

interruptionSensitivity.description: How readily the agent lets a caller interrupt (0-1).

language.description: BCP-47 locale for speech, e.g. en-US.

maxSilenceMs.description: Milliseconds of caller silence before the call ends.

modelTier.description: Model quality/speed tier: turbo, balanced, max, or realtime.

numbers.description: Phone numbers attached to this agent.

items.description: A phone number attached to the agent.

systemPrompt.description: Instructions for the hosted AI on calls, or null.

transferNumber.description: E.164 number calls transfer to, or null if disabled.

voice.description: Voice ID the agent speaks with.

voicemailMessage.description: Voicemail greeting text, or null if disabled.

hasMore.description: Whether more results exist beyond this page.

total.description: Total matching records across all pages.

title: List Agents
